title: hotfix: tightens SLO enforcer smoothing and hysteresis to prevent spurious regional failovers
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Today during a spike in cross-region traffic we observed the SLO enforcer triggering regional failover for several customers when transient metric noise briefly pushed the smoothed error rate above threshold. This caused unnecessary capacity shifts and customer-facing latency while the system recovered. Root cause: smoothing window and hysteresis were underspecified and the current exponential smoothing implementation used a float normalization that could underweight recent samples under high-sample-rate regimes. This PR tightens the smoothing parameters, adds explicit hysteresis on threshold crossing, and fixes an off-by-one in the smoothing weight calculation that made the half-life effectively much longer than configured. The change is intentionally conservative: we increase signal responsiveness while preventing oscillation by requiring a sustained exceedance for failover and adding a minimum cool-down before re-evaluation. What changed: 1) smoothing.go: corrected weight computation and introduced configurable hysteresis window and min-cooldown; 2) defaults.yaml: updated sane defaults for regional and global SLOs and documented the reasoning; 3) added an integration test that replays the incident traffic pattern and verifies no failover when the exceedance is shorter than hysteresis; 4) ops notes documenting mitigation and rollback instructions. Testing: unit + integration tests added and CI was re-run to verify stability. Rollout plan: immediate hotfix to main and backported to the latest release branch; feature flags added so safety can be toggled per-customer if needed. Related: ENG-4882 (incident), ENG-4910 (postmortem + follow-ups).

release_notes: Hotfix: prevent spurious regional failovers by tightening SLO smoothing and adding hysteresis/cooldown; backward compatible; reduces oscillation during transient spikes.
summary: Hotfix to SLO enforcer smoothing and hysteresis to avoid transient-triggered regional failovers. Includes bugfix to smoothing weight calculation, updated defaults, tests, and ops notes. Merged to main via squash. CI passed after a minor test fix.
